senses.en: the part at the end of the leg that you stand on

example.en: He injured his left foot while running.

senses.en: a unit of length equal to 12 inches (about 30.5 cm)

example.en: The table is three feet wide.

senses.en: the bottom or lower end of something

example.en: We camped at the foot of the mountain.

senses.en: to pay a bill or cost

example.en: Her company footed the bill for the trip.
example.zh: 她的公司支付了这次旅行的费用。

example.en: The patient waited quietly in the clinic.
example.zh: 那位病人在诊所里安静地等候。

senses.en: able to wait or accept difficulty calmly

example.en: She was patient with the slow learner.
example.zh: 她对那个学得慢的人很有耐心。
